items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Man, you got to have, you got to have this to work with Steve Plenty.

ctx.x: Louis Premham couldn't stand him one night. Not what she put on you. Man, you got to have, you got to have this to work with Steve Plenty. Man, need a dollar, mine is better to work for her. And she's going to try to get along, Bill. She's come to try with her cousin sometimes. I heard, yeah. I heard that. She's come to try with her cousin. She interfere with you. Tell you to tell the band something. She tell them to do what she wants to. Now you don't be doing that. Be doing that shit.
Yeah, it's amazing that she hasn't run out of musicians by now. She's been through most of the other players. She can't get nobody.
